env BOLERO_MODULE=off

# BOLERO_FLAGS sets flags for commands

env BOLERO_FLAGS='-e -f={{.Dir}} --test.benchtime=1s -count=10'
bolero list asdfasdfasdf  # succeeds because of -e
bolero list runtime
stdout '[\\/]runtime$'

env BOLERO_FLAGS=-race OLDGOARCH=$GOARCH OLDGOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=386 GOOS=linux
! bolero list runtime
stderr 'race is not supported on linux/386'

env GOARCH=$OLDGOARCH GOOS=$OLDGOOS

# bolero env succeeds even though -f={{.Dir}} is inappropriate
bolero env

# bad flags are diagnosed
env BOLERO_FLAGS=-typoflag
! bolero list runtime
stderr 'unknown flag -typoflag'

env BOLERO_FLAGS=-
! bolero list runtime
stderr '^bolero: parsing \$BOLERO_FLAGS: non-flag "-"'

env BOLERO_FLAGS=--
! bolero list runtime
stderr '^bolero: parsing \$BOLERO_FLAGS: non-flag "--"'

env BOLERO_FLAGS=---oops
! bolero list runtime
stderr '^bolero: parsing \$BOLERO_FLAGS: non-flag "---oops"'

env BOLERO_FLAGS=-=noname
! bolero list runtime
stderr '^bolero: parsing \$BOLERO_FLAGS: non-flag "-=noname"'

env BOLERO_FLAGS=-f
! bolero list runtime
stderr '^bolero: flag needs an argument: -f \(from (\$BOLERO_FLAGS|%BOLERO_FLAGS%)\)$'

env BOLERO_FLAGS=-e=asdf
! bolero list runtime
stderr '^bolero: invalid boolean value \"asdf\" for flag -e \(from (\$BOLERO_FLAGS|%BOLERO_FLAGS%)\)'

# except in bolero bug (untested) and bolero env
bolero env
stdout BOLERO_FLAGS

# Flags listed in BOLERO_FLAGS should be safe to duplicate on the command line.
env BOLERO_FLAGS=-tags=magic
bolero list -tags=magic
bolero test -tags=magic -c -o $devnull
bolero vet -tags=magic

# BOLERO_FLAGS uses the same quoting rules (quoted.Split) as the rest of
# the bolero command env variables
env BOLERO_FLAGS='"-tags=magic wizardry"'
bolero list

-- foo_test.go --
package foo
